mapper.sql: p.id, p.clan_id, p.branch_id, p.person_code, p.name, p.genealogy_name, p.courtesy_name, p.alias_name, p.gender, p.generation_no, p.generation_word, p.rank_in_family, p.birth_date, p.birth_date_precision, p.death_date, p.death_date_precision, p.is_living, p.birth_place, p.residence_place, p.occupation, p.education, p.title_or_honor, p.biography, p.tomb_place, p.epitaph, p.has_descendant, p.lineage_status, p.privacy_level, p.data_status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at

order by
lower(p.name) asc, p.id desc
p.generation_no asc nulls last, lower(p.name) asc, p.id desc
p.updated_at desc nulls last, p.id desc
mapper.select:
select from person p
order by p.id desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as people_total, count(*) filter ( where p.generation_no is not null or (p.generation_word is not null and p.generation_word <> '') ) as generation_maintained, count(*) filter ( where p.birth_date is not null or p.death_date is not null ) as vital_dates_maintained, count(*) filter ( where (p.biography is not null and p.biography <> '') or (p.epitaph is not null and p.epitaph <> '') or (p.title_or_honor is not null and p.title_or_honor <> '') ) as biography_maintained, count(*) filter ( where (p.generation_no is null and (p.generation_word is null or p.generation_word = '')) or (p.birth_date is null and p.death_date is null) ) as key_info_missing, count(distinct p.branch_id) filter (where p.branch_id is not null) as covered_branches from person p where p.clan_id = #{clanId} and p.data_status = #{dataStatus} and p.deleted_at is null

select 'gender'::text as dimension, coalesce(p.gender, 'unknown')::text as bucket_key, count(*) as bucket_count from person p where p.clan_id = #{clanId} and p.data_status = #{dataStatus} and p.deleted_at is null group by p.gender union all select 'living'::text as dimension, case when p.is_living is true then 'living' when p.is_living is false then 'deceased' else 'unknown' end as bucket_key, count(*) as bucket_count from person p where p.clan_id = #{clanId} and p.data_status = #{dataStatus} and p.deleted_at is null group by p.is_living union all select 'generation'::text as dimension, coalesce(p.generation_no::text, 'unmaintained') as bucket_key, count(*) as bucket_count from person p where p.clan_id = #{clanId} and p.data_status = #{dataStatus} and p.deleted_at is null group by p.generation_no union all select 'branch'::text as dimension, coalesce(p.branch_id::text, 'unmaintained') as bucket_key, count(*) as bucket_count from person p where p.clan_id = #{clanId} and p.data_status = #{dataStatus} and p.deleted_at is null group by p.branch_id
